content_fields.title: Protect audit information and logs against unauthorized access
content_fields.description: Protect audit records from unauthorized access and modification.
content_fields.guidance: Audit records should be shipped off the generating host promptly, stored append-only with restricted read access, retained for the required period and monitored for gaps that would indicate tampering.
content_fields.found: The application writes no audit log today and the containers have no log shipping configured, so there is no protected store to speak of.
content_fields.missing: Central log storage with access control, retention and integrity protection.
content_fields.conclusion: Protecting audit records requires log infrastructure outside this repository; producing the records is tracked separately under the structured audit logging countermeasure.
content_fields.action: The security operations team should provide access-controlled, append-only log storage for this service.
